raw_response:
This fruit plot is small and rented, so I will manage it with what my family can afford and do ourselves. I do not want to spend much on chemical inputs because they are costly and not easy to get on time here. I will use some manure if I can collect it, keep the plot by hand, and depend on the rains. I will not hire labor unless there is a problem, so for now I plan to use only family work.
